recipe.name: Snow Fungus Soup with Asian Pears
directions: Soak snow fungus firstly until soft (around 30 minutes ). Then move the yellow end. Hand shred into small chunks.
Prepare a high pressure cooker, place the sow fungus pieces in, goji berries, pears, add red dates and rock sugar. Add enough clean water. Press soup, 10 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue heating for another 10 minutes to get the right texture.
Add all the ingredient in a soup pot. And heat for 30 minutes on midium heat. Keep the content boiling.

ingredients.name: Snow Fungus
ingredients.notes: dried, 25g (around 3/4 head, remove the yellow end

ingredients.name: Rock Sugar
ingredients.notes: alt: more based on personal preference

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.notes: for high pressure cooker or 2L for regular cooker

ingredients.name: Asian Pear
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into small cubes
